caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned flat iron, centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The iron is composed of a dark brownish metal, showing rusty spots and varying tones of brown representing aging and wear. The body of the iron has a slightly curved, triangular shape with a flat base and a gently sloping top surface. Ornamental cutouts or slots are visible on the side of the iron's body. Above the body, a thick, oval-shaped handle is attached, matching the metal texture and color of the body, with visible shading and highlights indicating its three-dimensional form. No other objects, decorations, or background elements are present in the composition.
